svg.title: Digital lathe gearbox - system wiring
svg.text: E-stop NC1 in series with K1 coil (+5 V): opens K1, removes +48 V (hardware stop)
0 V (PSU V−) to CL57T GND, 16 AWG
+5 V (also: AHCT125 VCC, encoder, K1 coil, LEDs)
INTERFACE BOARD (perfboard / PCB): logic GND star at the Teensy GND pin

g.text: SW2 off, SW3 on, SW4 on
not in the CL57T ENA circuit
• E-stop: NC1 drops K1 in the +48 V feed. It is NOT wired to ENA (energised ENA opto disables the CL57T). NC2 goes to pin 23.
• ENA high = motor disabled; firmware drives pin 7 LOW to enable. The 10 k pull-up to 3V3 keeps the driver off while the Teensy boots.
• Shields grounded at one end only. PE star at the enclosure stud: inlet PE, PSU FG, lathe bed, motor-cable shield at the driver.
• Keep the motor cable and 48 V wiring at least 100 mm from the encoder, STEP/DIR and button wiring.
• Pin numbers per docs/DESIGN.md (authoritative). Details, DIP tables and bring-up: docs/WIRING.md.

svg.text: Mains → PSU 48 V → K1 → CL57T → motor
